v-on, keyAlias.description: Key Aliases, System Modifier Keys, Mouse Button Modifiers...

v-bind=\"$attrs\".description: In combination with `inheritAttrs: false`, apply attributes to some other element instead of the root element.

v-on=\"$listeners\".description:
In combination with `inheritAttrs: false`, apply listeners to some other element instead of the root element.
Vue 3.x removed. (merged into $attrs)

v-bind=\"$attrs\" v-on=\"$listeners\".description: In combination with `inheritAttrs: false`, apply attributes and listeners to some other element instead of the root element.

v-text.description: Updates the element's `textContent`. Prefer mustache interpolation `{{ }}` unless the whole text node is replaced.

v-html.description:
Updates the element's `innerHTML`.
**The content is inserted as plain HTML — never use it on user-supplied input**, it opens an XSS hole. Scoped-CSS styles do not apply inside it.

v-once.description: Renders the element or component once and skips it on later updates.

v-pre.description: Skips compilation for this element and all its children — mustaches are rendered verbatim.

v-cloak.description: Stays on the element until the instance finishes compiling. Paired with `[v-cloak] { display: none }` it hides un-compiled mustaches when using in-DOM templates.

v-bind.description: Dynamically binds an attribute or a component prop. `:attr` is shorthand for `v-bind:attr`.

v-bind, object.description: Binds every property of an object as an attribute or prop.

v-bind, dynamic argument.description:
Vue 2.6+. Dynamic argument — the attribute name itself comes from an expression.
The expression must evaluate to a string or `null`; in in-DOM templates it has to be lowercase, since browsers lowercase attribute names.

v-bind, .sync modifier.description:
**Vue 2 only — removed in Vue 3** (replaced by `v-model:argument`).
Vue 2.3+. Sugar for `:title="value" @update:title="value = $event"`; the child updates it with `this.$emit('update:title', newValue)`.

v-bind, .prop modifier.description: Binds as a DOM property instead of an attribute.

v-bind, .camel modifier.description: Vue 2.1+. Converts a kebab-case attribute name to camelCase — needed for SVG attributes such as `viewBox` in in-DOM templates.

v-on, dynamic argument.description: Vue 2.6+. Dynamic argument — the event name itself comes from an expression.

v-on, .native modifier.description:
**Vue 2 only — removed in Vue 3** (all listeners land in `$attrs` and are applied by `inheritAttrs`).
Listens for a native DOM event on the component's root element instead of a custom event.

v-on, self.description: Only fires when the event was dispatched from this element itself, not from a descendant.

v-on, capture.description: Uses the capture phase — the handler runs before the event reaches its target.

v-on, passive.description: Vue 2.3+. Marks the listener as passive, so the browser need not wait to see whether `preventDefault()` is called. Do not combine with `.prevent`.

v-model, .number modifier.description: Casts the input to a Number; falls back to the original string when the cast yields `NaN`.

v-model, .trim modifier.description: Trims leading and trailing whitespace from the input.
